grammar.title: Adjective agreement and evidence
grammar.overview: Control masculine and feminine adjective agreement, degree expressions and reasons that prove a judgement.

rules.heading: Adjective agreement
rules.formula: هُوَ + صِفَةٌ مُذَكَّرَةٌ / هِيَ + صِفَةٌ مُؤَنَّثَةٌ
rules.explanation: The adjective matches the person described. Many feminine forms add ـةٌ.

rules.heading: Ask what someone is like
rules.explanation: Use كَيْفَ with the correct pronoun, then answer with a complete description.

rules.heading: Strengthen or soften a description
rules.explanation: Degree expressions make the judgement more precise.

rules.heading: Justify with evidence
rules.explanation: A convincing description includes behaviour that proves the adjective.

grammar.common_error: Do not describe a female person with an unmodified masculine adjective.

quiz.feedback: A feminine subject requires feminine adjectives.

listening.script: تَتَحَدَّثُ نُورُ عَنْ زَمِيلَتِهَا سَلْمَى. تَقُولُ إِنَّ سَلْمَى هَادِئَةٌ وَصَبُورَةٌ، وَلٰكِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ خَجُولَةً. هِيَ وَاثِقَةٌ عِنْدَمَا تَتَحَدَّثُ أَمَامَ الفَصْلِ، وَمُتَعَاوِنَةٌ لِأَنَّهَا تُسَاعِدُ الطَّالِبَاتِ الجَدِيدَاتِ. أَحْيَانًا تَكُونُ جَادَّةً جِدًّا، وَلٰكِنَّهَا مَرِحَةٌ مَعَ صَدِيقَاتِهَا.
